notes_en: Login page now has a video background: the video plays muted and loops
Language switch is now at the top of the login page: العربية | English — the whole app flips instantly
The points dialog now shows a gold loading spinner with “Adding your points…” while you wait
English is now complete: loading messages, toasts, badges and prices all translate

Opening an episode with points removes its lock from the episode list right away
If the ad asks you to confirm you are human, tick the box so the ad opens
